description:
Fill every place, bill every family correctly and see your cash 13 weeks ahead: 8 Excel workbooks for a home daycare or childcare center. 29 dollars once, no subscription, no macros.

Childcare management software is usually billed every month, often per enrolled child. This suite is 29 dollars, once.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
✓ Rank waiting families by the tuition each brings and fill every free place with the best match
✓ See free places by room and weekday and check every hour against your own staff ratio
✓ Send the right invoice to every family, with sibling discounts, late pickup fees and deposits worked out
✓ Chase balances by 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days and see your cash 13 weeks ahead
✓ Cost every menu day and keep record status, incidents and drills up to date
✓ Run only the camp weeks that break even and find the room that loses money

WHAT IS INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS
1 Enquiries, Tours and Waitlist
2 Rooms, Places and Attendance
3 Staff, Rota and Ratios
4 Tuition, Fees and Invoices
5 Payments, Balances and Cash
6 Meals, Health and Safety Records
7 Families, Programs and Camps
8 Business Health and Planning
Every workbook has 20 tables, 18 calculators, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready text messages, 30 dashboard figures, 22 charts and 6 gauges: {pages} ready pages in all. Each part comes blank and as a copy filled with sample data, so every page works before you add your own.

WHO IT IS FOR
Owner-directors and assistant directors of a childcare center with 1 to 5 rooms, and home daycare providers working alone with one room of mixed ages.
NOT FOR: a live parent app, photo sharing, tablet check-in or card payments. These are workbooks, not a web service. Ratios, fees and targets are your own settings: check your local rules. Health and safety records hold status and dates only, never medical detail.

HOW IT WORKS
1 Open the workbook for the job.
2 Type your own rows in the coloured input cells.
3 Read the dashboard and use the calculators.

FILE FORMAT
Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. No macros, no subscription. Dates follow your computer's regional format and the currency symbol changes in one cell. Formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password), and instructions are on the first sheet.

GUARANTEE
If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

faq.q: Does it work in Google Sheets?
faq.a: Yes. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice (free). They use the same engine as our published suites, which were tested in Google Sheets. Upload the file to Google Sheets and open it.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency and date format?
faq.a: Yes. Dates follow the regional format of your computer, and the currency symbol changes in one cell. Fees, rates, ratios and targets are your own settings.

faq.q: I run a home daycare on my own: does it fit?
faq.a: Yes. Use one room with mixed ages and the same sheets. Part 8 has a home-daycare mode that turns rooms or hours into business cost lines, tests one-room capacity and checks your owner draw.

faq.q: What if a file does not work as described?
faq.a: We fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days. That is the store's real policy, and it applies to every file in the download.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data, and where do I start?
faq.a: Yes. Every part comes blank and as a copy filled with sample data. Explore the sample copy, then type your own rows in the coloured input cells of the blank file. Start with the part that hurts most today, such as invoices or the waiting list.

faq.q: Is there a fee per child, a subscription or any macros?
faq.a: No. You pay 29 dollars once. There are no macros and no per-child or monthly fee. It is not a parent app and does not take card payments.
